Answer Choices:
A. QJs
B. None of these 
C. 99
D. AJo
E. AKo

Near the bubble with a 16bb stack, ICM pressure forces an extremely tight UTG+1 jamming range—essentially only the very top of your range that both has massive equity when called and denies equity to the big stacks behind. AKo is the only hand among the options that comfortably meets that bar: it dominates all weaker Ax holdings, has strong equity vs. the premiums that will call, and retains fold equity against the many medium-strength hands that will over-fold in a money-bubble spot.
